entities.name: PMID:31462239 ABCG4 RNAi
observations: In Anopheles stephensi larvae, ABCG4 siRNA increased 24-hour permethrin-associated mortality from 45.6% to 64% and 58.4% for two siRNAs; Vivo-Morpholino results were consistent, supporting a functional defense role.

entities.name: PMID:25073980 Verapamil
observations: In Anopheles stephensi larvae, verapamil reduced permethrin LD50 from 0.137 to 0.025 mg/L; this supports ABC-transporter involvement but is not gene-specific. Permethrin also induced AnstABCG4 expression.

entities.name: PMID:28302529 ABC expression
observations: Permethrin exposure up-regulated AnstABCB2, AnstABCBmember6, and AnstABCG4 transcripts in adult Anopheles stephensi; expression association does not establish individual gene function.

entities.name: PMID:25504146 ABC time course
observations: In Anopheles stephensi larvae, ABCB- and ABCG-subfamily transcripts were induced after permethrin treatment, with expression peaking around 6 hours; this is expression evidence, not a functional perturbation.
